title: Exact Theory and Optimal Stepsizes for Stochastic Gradient Descent in Smooth Convex Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.42048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work considers the design of stepsize schedules for stochastic gradient descent in smooth convex optimization. Throughout, we assume that gradient noise is conditionally zero-mean with bounded variance. Among problems with dimension $d\geq N+1$, we provide an exact worst-case analysis of the expected suboptimality of stochastic gradient descent's final iterate. Our analysis applies to any (potentially nonconstant) schedule of $N$ stepsizes in $[0,1.5]^N$. Here, exact means that we provide a matching objective function and noise distributions where our guarantee is attained. Whenever the variance bound is at least $\Omega(1/\sqrt{N})$, our theory provides the minimax optimal stepsize schedule for stochastic gradient descent and proves its uniqueness. These optimal stepsizes monotonically decrease, ruling out any accelerations in expected final suboptimality from fixed fractal schedules observed in the deterministic case.

translated_title: 光滑凸最小化中随机梯度下降的精确理论与最优步长
translated_abstract: 本工作考虑光滑凸优化中随机梯度下降步长调度的设计。我们始终假设梯度噪声条件均值为零且方差有界。在维度 $d\geq N+1$ 的问题中，我们对随机梯度下降最终迭代的期望次优性给出了精确的最坏情况分析。我们的分析适用于 $[0,1.5]^N$ 中任意（可能非常数的）$N$ 个步长的调度。这里的“精确”是指我们提供了与之匹配的目标函数和噪声分布，使得我们的保证恰好被达到。只要方差界限至少为 $\Omega(1/\sqrt{N})$，我们的理论就为随机梯度下降提供了极小极大最优的步长调度，并证明了其唯一性。这些最优步长单调递减，从而排除了确定性情形中观察到的固定分形调度对期望最终次优性所带来的任何加速效果。
tldr: 该论文对光滑凸优化中随机梯度下降的期望次优性给出了精确的最坏情况分析，并在方差界限足够大时证明了唯一且单调递减的极小极大最优步长调度。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an exact worst-case analysis of the expected suboptimality of stochastic gradient descent in smooth convex optimization and, when the variance bound is sufficiently large, establishes the unique minimax optimal stepsize schedule, which is monotonically decreasing.
